QuestInfo.name: Stranded 1
QuestInfo.0: Is there really no way off the island? There must be a way. Ask Cutter.
QuestInfo.1: Cutter told you that the island isn't really that bad, once you get used to it. When you asked about getting off the island, he dodged your question and told you that Starfish Meat is really delicious. If he's not going to answer your question, you might as well try out this Starfish Meat.\n
QuestInfo.2: Cannon travel? It sounds ridiculous...but it's not like you have any better ideas.

0.0: Right, that's my story! Now, how did YOU get here? You wreck your ship testing a new pirate super weapon too?\r\n#L0##bI was on my way to Maple Island for Explorer training, and... (You explain about Balrog, and skip the part about the monkey saving you.)#l\n#k
0.1: Is that so? Well, you survived your first dance with Balrog. That's gotta count for something. I guess you met the monkey, too, right? Probably saved your life, by the look of you. Yeah, maybe you weren't meant to be an Explorer.\r\n#L0##bCutter, I really don't want to hate the only other person on this island. Now, how do we escape?#l\n#k
0.2: Escape? HA! Kid, if I knew how to escape, would I still be here? NO. I'd be blowing things up in peace back home. I suggest you start making yourself comfortable.\r\n#L0##bWhat? No, come on! I want to get out of here!#l\n#k
0.3: Hey, the island's not that bad. Plenty of food, no responsibilities... You're safe, too. I think the monkey's trained in first aid. Oh, come on, don't make that face! Look, I'll prove it to you. Let's have a pleasant first meal, eh? I just need you to head to the #bright side of the island#k.

yes.0: When you go to the right side of the island, you'll see plenty of #rFloppy Starfish#k. Grab me a bunch of them, and we'll roast 'em up! Trust me, they taste better than they look. Or smell. If you whack #r10 Starfish#k, you should get at least#b3 Starfish Meats#k to bring me.

no.0: Look, you can get mad and pitch a fit, or you can chill with me. Either way, you're still stuck on this island.

1.0: You got that Starfish Meat? Great, roasting time! ...Except we're out of kindling. Dang it!

item.0: You still don't have the #bStarfish Meat#k? How is that possible? #bRight side#k of the island! #rStarfish#k! Whack them!
